differences: CircularList requires a positive capacity. Zero capacity is rejected rather than constructing the degenerate upstream array.
Rust uses usize list lengths and indexes; empty pop and invalid splice ranges return errors rather than creating negative JavaScript lengths.
Captured closures replace thisArgs. Rust events borrow payloads, and EmitError represents the upstream dispose-during-fire TypeError.
Cloning Rust elements copies values. Rc elements preserve JavaScript mutable object identity.
EventUtils.any combines a homogeneous Rust payload type; erase payloads explicitly for the heterogeneous JavaScript void overload.
